policy.existing_regional_coordinates: Replace where needed; the old schematic supplies no measured distance or fixed compass orientation.
policy.preserve: The accepted project-authored cataract art language and human object scale.
policy.revisable: All regional positions, outlines and dimensions, including the cataract's chosen 38 m drop and 40 m upper width.
policy.range_meaning: Invented candidate route lengths for a first terrain draft, not source measurements, confidence intervals or straight-line separations.
policy.layout_method: Fit all shared routes, crossings, habitats and sightlines jointly before assigning final coordinates. Do not uniformly enlarge the schematic.
policy.orientation: Axes and north remain editorial. Left/right descriptions are tied to the narrator's viewpoint. Several moons prevent assuming every moonrise is terrestrial east.
policy.time: Use elapsed travel as a qualitative scale check; do not convert every hour to a fixed walking distance.
policy.state: Keep source-observed dry/restored changes separate from predictions, dreams, imagined scenes and cross-world transitions.

constraints.relationship: The great river divides at its fall; Evil Wood lies between the branches and is visible on the far horizon from the cataract.
constraints.design_freedom: Branch courses, wood extent, exact distances, waterfall height and width.

constraints.relationship: The first branch is an extensive rocky plain with innumerable water-runs; the second is another channel network with increasing dwarf fruit trees toward the valley.
constraints.design_freedom: Widths, bends, subdivisions and restored water distribution; full travel durations are not measured bank-to-bank widths.

constraints.relationship: Mara's cottage stands on rock in deep sand after a long approach from the channels. It belongs to the interbranch return itinerary, many desert miles below the cataract, and connects through an easy crossing to the ridge and monster basin.
constraints.design_freedom: Exact cottage coordinates, approach paths and crossing sites.

constraints.relationship: The baby-finding forest extends from the valley to the hot stream. Nest trees occupy a sparsely undergrown region; fruit remains accessible. The hall lies on the returning journey with the nests still far away.
constraints.design_freedom: Forest boundary, internal habitats, local connection of individual groves and distances. Sparse stones in the nest forest are a habitat constraint.

constraints.relationship: Vane sees the carriage before walking ten paces after leaving the hall, then approaches it. The passage measures travel before sighting, not full object separation.
constraints.design_freedom: Nearby object position and geometry, subject to the sightline. No ten-pace separation cap is imposed.

constraints.relationship: The hot stream is deep and brim-full but nowhere more than a few yards wide, at the forest/plain boundary. Nearby upstream hills contain a small cave spring that rises quietly from its floor.
constraints.design_freedom: Exact width, course, hills and cave form. No established connection to the great river; no internal cataract.

constraints.relationship: Substantial grassland separates the crossing and city. Vane travels all day and continues toward dawn; the expedition and return have separate travel/rest stages. Vegetable gardens and refuse surround the walls.
constraints.design_freedom: Plain dimensions, approach route and city plan. A few hundred yards outside the gate describes an individual rest site, not the whole plain.

constraints.relationship: Fine sand conceals the upper dry course. Restoration produces a deep, broad, quiet river through grassy plains and flowering forests; the burial spot disappears and water comes from far beyond it.
constraints.design_freedom: Upper distances and landforms. The hand-site is an event location, not the source.

constraints.relationship: Beyond greater forests and a far plain stands a solitary mountain city explicitly unlike Bulika. The river flows from the peak through its main street and broad steps, with shallower stairs along its banks.
constraints.design_freedom: Upstream distance, mountain height, architecture and cloud scene. Do not merge the city with Bulika or every earlier distant hill.

constraints.relationship: Earth and the strange country connect through transitions. The restored orchard lake and Evil Wood island are anticipated rather than fully surveyed. Dream terrain requires separate treatment; the monster lake is subsequently witnessed.
constraints.design_freedom: Portal presentation, provisional shorelines and editorial orientation. Avoid implying ordinary ground adjacency or dream confirmation.
